title: Polynomial Curve Systems are Exponentially Decaying
summary: The existence of a finite global attractor for polynomial curve system has been known since the work of Belk et al. [5]. However, except in the hyperbolic case, the rate at which the pullback of a curve under a polynomial converges to the attractor remained unclear. In this paper, we introduce the notions of $\textit{quick returns}$ and $\textit{barrier lakes}$ to analyze the combinatorial models of curves.
